_doc:
Design OPTIONS for the user to pick (user 2026-11-09: the user picks every character design from an option sheet; nothing else is
drawn for these characters until the pick is relayed). Writes this demo's project/web_prompts.json option jobs (opt_<char>_<a|b|c>),
rendered with python3 tools/openai/images.py <demo> <jobs…> --quality medium (cheap: options only; the picked design is redrawn at
high quality as the base pose later). Same file in Demo46–50; the table for this folder is chosen by the folder name.
Run: python3 scripts/design_options.py

opt_naomi_a.prompt:
Image 1 is the STYLE and CHARACTER reference (image 2: closer face reference).

Image 1 and 2 are the user's REAL cat Naomi: draw exactly this cat — a long-haired blue-grey and white bicolour cat, white inverted-V blaze on the forehead, white ruff, chest, belly and mittens, darker grey plush tail, big round olive / yellow-green eyes, small pink nose, no collar, no clothes. A realistic cat on four legs (not anthropomorphic), high-finish healing visual-novel illustration, warm afternoon summer light.

Naomi on a hot summer afternoon in a Japanese tatami room (she stays exactly herself — only the summer props around her differ).

Option A (props set A): Naomi lying flat like a cat-loaf on a cool bamboo summer mat, a small white electric fan with a mesh guard and a little paper streamer behind her, a glass wind chime hanging at the window.

Wide 16:9 illustration of the whole little scene in a sunny Japanese tatami room (Naomi with ALL the props named above clearly visible around her). No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no UI.
